alerts.title: No Water Available in Park
alerts.description: Water systems throughout the park have been shut off for the winter season, October to April. Please plan ahead and bring your own drinking water.

alerts.title: Cashless Operations
alerts.description: Black Canyon's operations are now cashless. South Rim Campground is by reservation only via Recreation.gov. East Portal & North Rim campground sites are first-come first-served and accept payment using Scan & Pay through Recreation.gov's mobile app.
